commit_message: Renderer: apply PBR texture inputs in StandardLit
pr_title: Renderer: add PBR material texture contract
pr_body: Phase 2B renderer foundation. StandardLit now consumes packed roughness/metallic from G/B, ambient occlusion from R, and normal scale in tangent space. AO modulates only the indirect ambient term; direct lighting, ToonLit, Unlit, emissive output, and the independent outline pass remain unchanged.
